game_concept: A arcade set in Sand Dunes – Bone Valley, a valley of bleached bones: the sand ranger must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Integration Heist: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Bone Valley.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bone Valley: a valley of bleached bones
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Valley, repeat each round: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Bone Valley. Each round, a new rope bundles challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the heist value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of rope bundles by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Integration Heist
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Integration Heist' (Week 9 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Bone Valley'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how heist changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Bone Valley.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 440 within 38 seconds.
